metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for current renal-biopsy materials using available clinical records.

PATHOLOGY REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4301
The nephrology service requests an update on the current renal-biopsy material. Reference: RBX-V3-4301.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT ENCOUNTER
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4301
Creatinine rose from 1.4 to 2.6 mg/dL across four days. Urinalysis has red cells and protein. The preliminary light-microscopy description notes segmental necrosis in two glomeruli.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
SPECIMEN HISTORY
The procedure record says two cores were obtained. The grossing note lists nine glomeruli for light microscopy and one fragment sent for immunofluorescence. The immunofluorescence accession timestamp is four hours after collection.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
PATHOLOGY EVIDENCE
The immunofluorescence worksheet remains in processing. A serum ANCA result was drawn before the biopsy but has not finalized. A resident preliminary line mentions crescents; the attending sign-out field is blank.
